g.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
g.text: RUN OPTIONS - apply to ALL queued items of each tool
[x] -u, --update Skip files that are newer on the target (safety net)
[ ] -n, --dry-run Show what would happen, change nothing
[ ] -c, --checksum Compare by checksum, not size + time (slow)
[ ] --ignore-existing Never touch files that exist on the target
[ ] -L, --copy-links Follow symlinks, copy what they point to
[ ] -I, --ignore-times Copy every file again, overwriting the target
> [x] --delete Delete target files that aren't in the source (sync)
Command for item #1 of 1 (other rclone items get their own paths):
CAUTION: these rclone flags can delete or overwrite data, write outside the target or run commands: --delete
Note: -l/--links is left out for copies INTO a local folder - symlinks from a remote stay .rclonelink files
there, so they can't point outside the target.
Note: --delete makes folder items run 'rclone sync' instead of 'rclone copy'; single files are still copied with
[Space] Toggle [E] Edit as text [D] Defaults [Enter] Confirm & run [Esc] Cancel
